property_summary: For any initialize(...) call the contract stores the provided _changeFee into the public changeFee state (i.e. c.changeFee() == _changeFee); the mutant decrements non-zero _changeFee by 1 causing mismatch for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace storing of changeFee with storing of changeFee - 1 (decrement) so initialized changeFee differs by -1 (underflow prevented by type).
